note: Cameras of the space-scene posters (PLAN_final S1, S2; unit U3). Galaxy-agnostic: every length is in kpc or in units of the galaxy's R200c, every direction is built from the story sightline (n = beam direction p0 -> p1, u = unit vector from the galaxy centre to the beam's closest point, w = u x n). Forward f = cos(tilt) n + sin(tilt) w; image right e1 = sin(tilt) n - cos(tilt) w; image up e2 = u; then image axes are rolled: e1' = e1 cos(roll) + e2 sin(roll), e2' = -e1 sin(roll) + e2 cos(roll). A beam point at s kpc from the closest point (s > 0 toward p1, the quasar end) lands at (x, y) = (s sin(tilt), b) before the roll and at (x cos(roll) + y sin(roll), -x sin(roll) + y cos(roll)) after it, so the scenes can place the beam without the poster. Orthographic. Origin = galaxy centre at the image centre. Square stills so one image serves landscape and portrait stages (the scenes fade the edges radially).
